title: HC wave — pricing tipping points & capacity playbook
content:
Purpose and scope:
Quick interactive workbook for planning a two-wave headcount ramp tied to observed pricing moves in the market. This is intentionally lightweight — used in weekly ops + finance syncs to recommend a gating rule-set (hire / pause / accelerate) tied to unit economics and GPU availability.

High-level assumptions (back-of-envelope):
- Baseline ARR growth = 58% YoY for the product portfolio we expect to influence.
- Inference units: 1 inference unit ~ 1k tokens equivalent (internal metric).
- Avg throughput per A100 reserved hour = 1.8M inference units (workload-mix dependent).
- Spot hours cost = 0.32 * reserved hourly cost; but tail risk of 20% preemption.
- Average price per 1M inference units today = $12.5 (hosted mix).
- Target unit margin bands: healthy > $7/1M, acceptable $3–7, unsustainable < $3.

Scenario lattice (conservative / base / upside) — monthly cadence, 6 months:
CSV table (Month, Net new hires, Target reserved GPU hours, Target spot GPU hours, Expected inference units/day (k), COGS ($k), Revenue ($k), Avg price per 1M, Unit margin $/1M)
Nov-25, 0, 120, 40, 3,200, 430, 1.2M, 12.5, 6.8
Dec-25, 6, 180, 60, 4,600, 645, 1.8M, 12.0, 6.2
Jan-26, 12, 300, 80, 7,200, 990, 2.9M, 11.2, 5.6
Feb-26, 8, 340, 100, 8,100, 1,150, 3.2M, 10.5, 5.0
Mar-26, 0, 340, 90, 8,400, 1,210, 3.4M, 9.8, 4.1
Apr-26, 0, 340, 60, 8,900, 1,240, 3.5M, 9.0, 3.0

Notes on the table: COGS includes GPU, storage, networking + marginal infra. Revenue = billed (hosted + dedicated blends). Unit margin computed post-infra but pre-SG&A.

Pricing sensitivity grid (one-way):
- If avg price per 1M falls by $1.5 -> unit margin decreases ~ $1.5 (direct pass-through) -> triggers: hold wave-2 hires if margin < $4.
- If reserved GPU price increases 10% regionally (APAC spot shock) -> blended COGS +$120k/mo -> if COGS increase > 6% of revenue -> consider: slow recruiting and shift 20% workload to cheaper quantized model variant.

Tipping points and gating rules (operational):
- Hire-wave 1 (initial 12 hires) executed when: trailing 4-week revenue growth >= 5% and unit margin >= $5.5.
- Hire-wave 2 (follow-on 8 hires) only execute when: unit margin >= $5.5 AND 30-day reserved utilization >= 72% without >10% growth in spot preemption month-over-month.
- Emergency freeze: if unit margin < $3 OR revenue QoQ change < -3%, implement hiring freeze and run 14-day cost-reduction scrimmage.

GPU mix playbook (notes):
- Prefer 70:30 reserved:spot for predictable product lanes; 50:50 for experimental models.
- Maintain a 10% short-term burst reserve for high-priority enterprise customer incidents (paid by addon credit).
- Quantization fallback list per model (low-latency tier) to re-route 15–25% of traffic when cost thresholds hit.

Sensitivity outputs (quick):
- Price per 1M = $13.5 -> projected unit margin = $7.8 -> runway improves ~ +5 weeks on current cash plan.
- Price per 1M = $9.0 -> projected unit margin = $2.5 -> recommend immediate hiring pause + reprioritize product roadmap features not revenue-creating.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Need updated A100 vs H100 benchmarking for mixed-precision quantized inference — ask Applied ML for 2-week runbook (Diego).
- Confirm whether reserved GPU committed discounts can be re-allocated mid-quarter (legal/infra ask).
- Build a simple dashboard (Console) that exposes unit margin by route and 7-day moving average price per 1M. Owner: Priya.
- Verify carved-out enterprise credits and SLA uplift accounting in revenue recognition with Accounting (Samir).

Actions for next Finance + Ops sync:
- Run a weekly 'pricing chase'—collect actual billed avg price per 1M and reserved utilization; update this sheet and tag triggers.
- Prepare a fallback offer for top-20 customers to mitigate revenue loss if price compression continues (discounted reserved pool).

Appendix (quick sensitivity math):
- Marginal contribution per 1M = price_per_1M - cogs_per_1M. Estimated cogs_per_1M = (reserved_hourly_cost / throughput_per_hour) * 1M + allocation.
- Example: reserved_hourly_cost $6.4k for a pod -> throughput 1.8M -> cogs_per_1M ~= $3.56 + infra alloc = $2.2 => total $5.76 -> unit margin = price - 5.76.

Slack refs / meetings: #finance-weekly, #infra-costs, convo:slack/GC-2345

End of doc — this is a living sheet, treat numbers as rough.
